description: This file defines the DisplayContent class and related functions for handling display information, including parsing from protocol buffers, creating display cutouts, and adding attributes.

classes.name: DisplayContent
classes.description: Class representing display content with properties like id, activity, bounds, rotation, and related display info.

classes.name: DisplayCutout
classes.description: Class representing display cutout details such as insets and bounds.

methods.description: Static method to create a DisplayContent instance from a protocol buffer object.

methods.description: Function to create a DisplayCutout object from proto data.
